analysis: Only CHANGELOG.md base_text excerpts (lines 427-836) were supplied; no patch or head text was visible. I found no security regression, new attack surface, or invalidated threat assumption in the supplied content. The excerpts describe changes already present in base: fail-closed attestation challenges (status_signature and Secure Boot now required for attested keys, matching the current TB-002 and TB-009 text), removal of the unauthenticated provider-earnings lookup (T-031), App Attest protocol 3 only, the MDM-optional serving path, and the legacy-compat floor (EIGENINFERENCE_MIN_PROVIDER_VERSION). Items for later passes: (1) the actual diff hunks for CHANGELOG.md were not provided, so I could not verify what the PR adds. (2) The changelog notes the live /etc/d-inference/env value must be raised manually to at least 0.9.5 before coordinator deploy. That is an operational dependency, not a code defect. (3) The canonical TB-009 text still says ARV is parsed but not enforced and describes protocol versions; this stays consistent with the changelog. No code files were supplied, so cross-file tracing of authorization, attestation, encryption, billing and availability was not possible. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety.
